bootstrap: Origin-stratified source-group resampling, same indices for every probe; percentile intervals; frozen fits and thresholds.
scope: Regroup the same frozen 30000-artwork primary cohort; transitive group identities preserved; greedy style/origin-balanced 60:20:20 allocation; all five probes retune C and threshold within each development/validation split. Cached frozen encoder embeddings reused; no new embedding extraction.
limitations: Conditional on the original selected cohort and cached features. These are five grouped repartitions, not five independent data collections. Original seed42 point estimates remain authoritative.
feature_calibration: Original seed42 development-calibrated feature thresholds fixed across repartitions. Only imputer/scaler/C/F1 threshold refitted. Conditional split sensitivity, not full pipeline replication.
